title: Manufacturing-constrained multi-objective optimization of local patch reinforcements for discontinuous fiber reinforced composite parts
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: In this work, contributes to the optimization of local continuous fiber reinforcement patches, under consideration of manufacturing constraints. This approach requires specific optimization strategies. Therefore, an multi-objective optimization strategy for the placement of local reinforcement patches, under consideration of manufacturing constraints, has been developed. During the multi objective optimization, structural and process related objectives are considered.
